purpose: Original sprites for the two mana visit buildings (Ley Well, Moonspring) added with the HoMM-style visit building set; the other buildings reuse existing original sprites.

images.prompt:

Moss and a few flagstones at its base. It refills a hero's magic when visited.

One object only, no ground tile, no scenery, no text, no letters, no frame. Plain transparent background.

Low reeds and smooth pebbles at the edge. It doubles a hero's magic once a week.
